origin: Hodgdon Reloading Manual 2024 and Western Powders Handloading Guide 8.0 (loads, velocities, PSI pressures; scripts/data/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 188 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (17 cartridges), velocity error 4.2 % rms, pressure error 13 % rms (published pressures). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
